posts.title: Most local businesses do not need more software

copy.default:
Most local businesses do not need more software.

They often already have booking tools, inboxes, spreadsheets and customer data.

The gap is knowing what should happen next and making existing tools work together.

Another subscription cannot replace a clear operating decision.

Use more of the system before buying more system.

posts.title: Some businesses are addicted to acquisition

copy.default:
Some businesses are addicted to acquisition.

New leads create visible activity.

Retention work is quieter: cleaner data, better timing, clearer journeys and consistent follow-up.

The excitement of acquisition can distract from customers already won.

Growth needs a front door and a reason to return.

posts.title: Your best marketing copy is hiding in customer replies

copy.default:
Your best marketing copy is hiding in customer replies.

Customers already tell you what they want, fear, misunderstand and value.

It appears in enquiries, reviews, objections, support questions and replies.

The language is usually clearer than the words created in a brainstorming session.

Before writing more copy, listen to the copy your customers are giving you.
